title: AC1027 MINSERT LTYPE XDATA target transport

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One MINSERT target in model-space ENTITIES and one MINSERT target in named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, each across all four source/output encoding pairs.
scope.linetype: Source-bound simple LTYPE using the existing MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA APPID provider.

xdata.payload: One ordered group-1005 soft-pointer to the MINSERT root.

proof.source: The physical AC1027 source records identify the INSERT roots, AcDbMInsertBlock subclass, exact grid fields, owners and named block names. Source capture binds each target handle to one exact live DRW_Insert and its unique referenced BLOCK_RECORD. Attribute and SEQEND compounds remain outside this profile.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations in each section check physical INSERT subclass, 2x3 grid, non-default 44/45 spacing, insertion point, scale, rotation, owner, block name, emitted BLOCK_RECORD dependency and remapped code-1005 reference. Fresh typed readback checks DRW_Insert grid counts/spacings, MINSERT classification and referenced block definition.
proof.failure_retry: Missing-target removal refuses export without replacing the existing destination and succeeds on same-adapter retry for each section/encoding combination. Separate late block-name mutation controls refuse and preserve the destination, then succeed after restoring the source name, for model-space and named-block targets.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 25.36 seconds); selector asserts the whole-test counts above

limits: This receipt qualifies the selected AC1027 2x3 MINSERT grid profile with column spacing 6 and row spacing 8, in model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, across authored ASCII/binary inputs and outputs. Other grid values and versions are not individually qualified.

The source matcher now admits positive-count INSERT grids without attached ATTRIB or SEQEND children; the selected exact fields here do not qualify attribute-bearing compounds, arbitrary grid output, or native array placement semantics.

This is selected source identity, block dependency, field transport, output/readback and transaction evidence. It does not establish independent CAD semantics, rendering, recursive document closure or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
